title: Hangover Cure Peruvian Potato Ball (Papa Rellena)
description: A creamy, smoky, and comforting Peruvian dish that's perfect for a hangover cure.
instructions: Roast the ancho chilies in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until charred.
Peel the roasted chilies and chop them into 1-inch pieces.
In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped potatoes, soy sauce, and lime juice to the pan. Cook for 5 minutes, until the potatoes are slightly tender.
Using a spoon, scoop out some of the potato mixture to make a well in the center.
Add the chopped cilantro, vegan mayonnaise, and roasted ancho chilies to the well.
Mix the potato mixture to seal the filling inside.
Form the potato mixture into 6-8 balls.
Place the potato balls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with a little olive oil and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
